metaDescription: Order custom As Colour headwear in bulk for your team. Shop premium hats and caps with your logo at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: As Colour headwear is known for its minimalist design and premium fabric quality, making it a popular choice for brands that want a clean, modern look. Whether you're outfitting a retail staff or a corporate event, these caps offer consistent sizing and durable construction that holds up to embroidery. Choose from structured or unstructured styles in a range of neutral tones that work well with single-color logos.
heroAltText: Custom As Colour headwear featuring embroidered logo on a structured cap in heather grey
